scope: Actual isolated router/process/Git tests using locally compiled fake provider executables. No real model, account, network, API, or subscription calls.

checks.name: expired login falls back to Gemini without model call on Codex
outage recovers and counts failed plus successful native usage once
hard quota moves to another subscription
code fallback uses a fresh worktree and preserves original checkout
cancellation stops active child and never launches fallback
whole-attempt timeout includes a hung login probe and falls back
timed out model retains partial native token usage before fallback
all provider quotas exhausted yields an honest coordinator handoff
workflow preserves scoped assignment and gates dependencies until reviewed
workflow rejects code scope drift without a permissive fallback
